We need propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to output JSON tree: root molecule, children reactions etc.

We need to select appropriate templates for each step: likely step1: amide formation (reverse: break amide to carboxylic acid and amine). Step2: Doebner modification reverse: break alpha,beta-unsaturated carboxylic acid to aldehyde + malonic acid? Actually forward Doebner: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated carboxylic acid. So retrosynthesis: break the unsaturated acid to aldehyde and malonic acid. In our target, we have /C=C/C(=O)N... that's an alpha,beta-unsaturated amide, not acid. But we could think the unsaturated acid precursor then amide formation later. So step1: amide formation (reverse) to give unsaturated acid and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Step2: Doebner modification reverse to give aromatic aldehyde (maybe p-tolyl?) and malonic acid. The aromatic aldehyde is attached to sulfonyl phenyl? Actually the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl sulfonyl group: ...c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)N...)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group from sulfonamide. So the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl ring (the sulfonyl phenyl). So the aldehyde precursor would be that phenyl ring with aldehyde at para position relative to sulfonyl? The target has phenyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl with para substituent being the unsaturated amide chain. So the aldehyde would be p-tolyl? Wait the chain is /C=C/C(=O)N... attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). So the aldehyde precursor would be that phenyl ring with aldehyde at that position (para). So step2: break the double bond and carbonyl to aldehyde + malonic acid.

Step3: sulfonamide formation reverse: break sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride and amine (the tolyl amine). So we need to get sulfonyl chloride (maybe p-toluenesulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the other phenyl with amine). Actually the sulfonamide is between the tolyl amine (first phenyl with methyl) and sulfonyl attached to second phenyl. The target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(... )cc2)cc1. So sulfonamide between tolyl amine (para-methyl phenyl) and sulfonyl attached to second phenyl. So reverse: break to give tolyl amine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride attached to second phenyl (p-sulfonyl chloride phenyl). So step3: sulfonamide formation.

Thus we need template IDs for these reactions. We can search template catalog.

Let's search for amide formation template (carboxylic acid + amine).
